name: Advertising Entity: Usage Example for Generic ads
description: Includes an implementation example regards how to use the generic provider.
project_description: Developer example submodule of the Advertising Entity (ad_entity) project, nested under ad_entity_generic. It contains no configuration and no PHP logic beyond attaching one JavaScript library on every page: it demonstrates how to register a custom load/remove handler on window.adEntity.generic to load and remove generic ads. The bundled js/example.loader.js is a heavily commented reference implementation showing the ad_tag object shape (id, el, name, format, targeting, done callback), how to unshift a handler to run early, how to consume the incoming ad_tags queue, how to check already-waiting tags on the global toLoad/toRemove queues, and how to signal completion via ad_tag.done(success, isEmpty). It is intended to be read and copied, not run in production (its handlers only console.log).
